exposure: Uterine malformations (bicorporeal uterus, septate uterus, hemi-uterus)
cohort: 411 women with congenital uterine anomalies and 14,936 women with a normal uterus who underwent first frozen-thawed embryo transfer cycles of IVF/ICSI
finding: Compared to women with a normal uterus, women with a bicorporeal uterus had a significantly lower live birth rate and lower birthweight, and women with a septate uterus had higher miscarriage rates and lower live birth rates.
mod_finding: Women with bicorporeal uterus had a higher cesarean rate compared to the control group, while mode of delivery outcomes for other uterine malformations were not significantly different.
birth_weight: Lower birthweight in the bicorporeal uterus group compared to controls
